reason: Endurance Technologies is acquiring the remaining stake in its German subsidiaries, consolidating ownership and potentially improving operational synergies and financial control.
why_now: The acquisition of the remaining 32% stake is being completed now, with a reported value of €18 million.
source_headlines: Endurance Technologies Limited: Endurance Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of remaining 32% stake in Stoeferle GmbH and Stoeferle Automotive GmbH by Endurance Overseas SpA, Italy, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company.
Endurance Technologies to acquire remaining 32% stake in German Stöferle companies for €18 million
